body.title: Grant and withdraw explicit WhatsApp consent
body.objective: Verify voluntary phone-bound permission without migrating legacy channel flags.
body.prerequisites: Owned local synthetic ERP and matching frontend build. Credentials are supplied privately. Provider-dependent checks require the isolated WhatsApp fixture with intercepted Meta transport; never use a real number, token or paid provider call. Keep credentials, consent phone data, raw callbacks and private payloads out of evidence. Registration does not certify an executed verdict.

steps.action: Sign in as a synthetic student, then open WhatsApp notifications from the account menu. Repeat as a campus manager and administrator, in light and dark themes.
steps.expected: The four notification families and withdrawal instructions are translated. No permission is granted by a pre-existing profile checkbox.

steps.action: Enable consent and enter a local-only phone number, then attempt to save.
steps.expected: Validation refuses the number; no consent grant is persisted.

steps.action: Use the same synthetic international number as the profile, explicitly check consent and save. Reopen the dialog.
steps.expected: The consent flag and bound number persist for this identity only.

steps.action: Uncheck consent and save; trigger a new synthetic event through the owned test fixture.
steps.expected: Consent is withdrawn. No provider call occurs; the in-app event remains available. Other users retain their own consent state.

body.title: Apply campus and tier monthly WhatsApp quotas
body.objective: Verify atomic cost accounting, isolation and exhaustion without actual Meta traffic.
body.prerequisites: Owned local synthetic ERP and matching frontend build. Credentials are supplied privately. Provider-dependent checks require the isolated WhatsApp fixture with intercepted Meta transport; never use a real number, token or paid provider call. Keep credentials, consent phone data, raw callbacks and private payloads out of evidence. Registration does not certify an executed verdict.

steps.action: In an owned disposable fixture, enable a supported campus tier and configure the intercepted provider. Open the notification delivery log.
steps.expected: The current UTC month, reserved count, tier ceiling and remaining allowance are displayed. Limits are 500, 2,000 and 5,000 for free, standard and premium.

steps.action: Place the current bucket one below its ceiling using the fixture, then concurrently trigger twelve eligible synthetic events.
steps.expected: Exactly one additional submission occurs. The reserved count reaches the ceiling and never exceeds it; in-app delivery remains available.

steps.action: As campus A manager, request campus B usage and attempt to replay a campus B notification.
steps.expected: Usage remains scoped to campus A; the foreign notification cannot be replayed or disclosed.

steps.action: Inspect a different campus and a prior UTC-month bucket.
steps.expected: Counters are independent by campus and UTC month. Missing/custom plans grant zero provider allowance. Failed or uncertain reserved submissions are not refunded.

body.title: Send only approved templates for the four event families
body.objective: Verify exact-language approved payloads and originating-module entitlement.
body.prerequisites: Owned local synthetic ERP and matching frontend build. Credentials are supplied privately. Provider-dependent checks require the isolated WhatsApp fixture with intercepted Meta transport; never use a real number, token or paid provider call. Keep credentials, consent phone data, raw callbacks and private payloads out of evidence. Registration does not certify an executed verdict.

steps.action: With Meta credentials absent, trigger results, exam grades, fee reminders and campus fraud events in the owned fixture.
steps.expected: No external call is made. In-app/email behavior is preserved and the WhatsApp channel is explicitly skipped.

steps.action: Configure only synthetic approved template pairs in the intercepted provider, then trigger eligible events with current matching consent.
steps.expected: Requests use type template and the configured approved name/language. Fee reminders include the cadence-specific text and ordered amount, currency and due-date parameters.

steps.action: Remove approval for the recipient language, then retry a preflight-skipped row.
steps.expected: No free-text or English fallback occurs and no submission slot is consumed.

steps.action: Set the originating module to read_only, hidden and enabled in the disposable fixture; refresh the campus log after each state.
steps.expected: Frozen/hidden emitters do not submit. Enabled emitters obey consent and quota. Existing notification history remains readable because notification is core.

body.title: Authenticate and reconcile Meta delivery receipts
body.objective: Verify byte-exact signature authentication and monotonic provider status.
body.prerequisites: Owned local synthetic ERP and matching frontend build. Credentials are supplied privately. Provider-dependent checks require the isolated WhatsApp fixture with intercepted Meta transport; never use a real number, token or paid provider call. Keep credentials, consent phone data, raw callbacks and private payloads out of evidence. Registration does not certify an executed verdict.

steps.action: Use the owned callback fixture to test the verification challenge with correct and incorrect tokens, then submit unsigned and body-tampered callbacks.
steps.expected: Only the correct verification token receives the exact plain-text challenge. Invalid or missing HMAC signatures are refused without notification mutation.

steps.action: Submit a valid signed delivered receipt for a known synthetic sender, recipient and message.
steps.expected: The delivery log shows delivered separately from provider acceptance; no in-app read flag is modified.

steps.action: Replay the delivered receipt, submit an older sent/failed receipt, then submit a correctly signed read receipt.
steps.expected: Duplicate/older states cannot regress delivery. Read advances the provider receipt and survives refresh.

steps.action: Submit a signed receipt with a different sender or recipient, and a callback for an unknown message.
steps.expected: No known notification is changed and no new inbox notification is created.

body.title: Prevent duplicate or unsafe WhatsApp replays
body.objective: Verify submission fencing, error privacy and legacy-row compatibility.
body.prerequisites: Owned local synthetic ERP and matching frontend build. Credentials are supplied privately. Provider-dependent checks require the isolated WhatsApp fixture with intercepted Meta transport; never use a real number, token or paid provider call. Keep credentials, consent phone data, raw callbacks and private payloads out of evidence. Registration does not certify an executed verdict.

steps.action: With the intercepted provider, simulate an acceptance timeout and run both the retry worker and a management replay.
steps.expected: The reserved slot remains counted. The outcome is shown as unconfirmed/failed with a translated safe reason; no second provider request occurs.

steps.action: Attempt a replay as another-campus manager and as a same-campus partner.
steps.expected: The management action is refused without exposing the notification or sending anything.

steps.action: Replay a synthetic legacy notification that has no WhatsApp receipt metadata, after configuring approval and matching consent.
steps.expected: A single submission initializes its receipt state and the matching signed callback advances it normally.

steps.action: Remove the unique usage index only inside a fresh owned disposable fixture and trigger an eligible event.
steps.expected: The provider call is refused before reservation/submission. The real preparation script can restore the required index without changing business records.
